title: Clover Chain Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
A single clover on a fine chain. One four petal clover of round clear cubic zirconia, about 9mm across, is set into a fine gold tone cable chain as its centre link, held at its two side petals so it lies flat on the wrist. Light enough to wear every day and to stack with other fine chains.

STYLING TIP: Stack it with the Clover Station Bracelet, one clover beside three.

Details

  • Clover: Approximately 9mm across, set as the centre link
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, four petals around a polished gold bead
  • Setting: Fine gold claws
  • Chain: Fine cable chain, approximately 1.5mm
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
